name: cmux.composer.command/1
docs: Slash commands in the agent chat composer. Each command is a row in the composer's / menu, beside the agent's and cmux's own; picking it writes its insert text over the typed /word. The daemon lists them (apps.composer.list) from the manifest, so no script runs and a save of the manifest updates the menu.

name.description: What the person types after /: lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

hint.description: What follows the command, shown after its name (<ticket>).

insert.description: The text written over the typed /word when the command is picked.

status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
